about.text: Butter churned from sweet cream, with an aromatic culture and a concentrate of lactic acid worked into it afterwards. This Dutch method, from the dairy institute NIZO, gives a cultured aroma without souring the cream and leaves a sweet buttermilk. Sold in Germany as mildgesäuerte Butter.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Made from skim milk with raised dry matter (evaporated or added skim milk powder), highly aromatic
Partly delactosed whey fermented with Lactobacillus helveticus, ultrafiltered, evaporated to about 16 % lactic acid
Sweet, because the cream was never soured
